verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS terminal and coding client. AI-assisted git features are a plausible axis for terminals and coding environments, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions AI-generated commit messages, git integration, or reading staged changes; the docs cover only SSH/Mosh, keys, themes, keyboard handling and VS Code connectivity.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated commit message suggestions based on my staged changes
